description:
Wire release record creation into the DM orchestrator pipeline end-to-end.

1. **Mint UUID at pipeline start** — only for non-dry-run, non-skip-packaging deployments (check `DryRun` and `SkipPackaging` flags).
2. **Create `releases` row** with status `pending` and `release_platforms` rows for each target platform.
3. **Add `ReleaseID` and `Channel` to `DeployDesktopRequest`** (orchestrator.go:24-55) so they flow through to S2D.
4. **Update `release_platforms`** as S2D reports per-platform build/upload results.
5. **Set status to `published`** when all platforms complete (or `failed` on error).
6. **Atomically supersede** the previous `published` release for the same profile+channel in the same transaction.
7. **Skip `CheckReleaseGate`** for nightly releases; enforce for beta and stable.
name: dm-orchestrator-release-record-integration
title: Integrate Release Record Creation Into DM Orchestrator Pipeline
